pabhāta.cp: masc. daybreak; dawn. (adj.) become clear or shining.
pabhāta.p: [Pa+bhā+ta] (na) Google Translate ပ ဘာ တ⁇ ္စ ဝိ ဘာ တ⁇ ္စ၊ I do not know what to do. Dhan.68. Callan Pitsu dies. . Dhan, T.68. . Amara, 4, 3. What Revelation ပြ ဘာ တ (န) ပြ + ဘာ + ဘာ ဝေက် တ၊ . ပြ ဘာ ယုက် တေ (ត្រី). [1) (a) Shining. (B) Morning - (2) Shining. Morning - Morning - Time. (Ti) (3) Bright - Bright. Morning-morning.
a: ပဘာတဉ္စ ဝိဘာတဉ္စ၊ ပစ္စူသော ကလ္လမပျထ။ ဓာန်။၆၈။ ကလ္လန္တံ ပစ္စူသေ။ ပဘာတျသ္မိံ လောကောတိ ပဘာတံ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၆၈။ ပြဘာတံ စ ဒိနာန္တေ တု, သာယံ သန္ဓျာ။ အမရ၊၎၊၃။ ဘာတုံ ပြဘာတမ်၊ ဗျာချာသုဓာ။ ပြဘာတ(န)ပြ+ဘာ+ဘာဝေ က္တ၊ ပြာတးကာလေ။ ပြဘာယုက္တေ(တြိ)။ ထောမ။] (၁)(က)ထွန်းလင်း-တောက်ပ-ခြင်း။(ခ)မိုးသောက်-မိုးလင်း-ခြင်း။(၂)ထွန်းလင်း-တောက်ပ-ရာ-အချိန်-အခါ၊ မိုးသောက်-မိုးလင်း-ချိန်။(တိ)(၃)ထွန်းလင်း-တောက်ပ-သော၊ မိုးသောက်-မိုးလင်း-သော။

pābhata：ပါဘတ （န） （တီ-ကိတ်） （ပ+အာ√ဘရ်+တ）
ယူဆောင်ခဲ့သော ပစ္စည်းဥစ္စာ။ ဥစ္စာအရင်း။
DOP: pabhāti pr. 3 sg. [ S. prabhāti], shines; illumines; Ja V 199, 22* (Khemā nadī himavantā ~āti, Ce, Ee, Se so, perhaps wr; Be himavatā pabhāvī; cf 200, 8´ : himavantato pavattati); 398, 29* (purimaṃ disaṃ kā tvaṃ ~āsi devate, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bhāsasi); — pp pabhāta , mfn. and n. [ S. prabhāta], 1. ( mfn. ) become light, shining; pabhātāya rattiyā, when night had become light; at daybreak; Ja II 33, 18 (so ~āya rattiyā pabbatamatthake nisinno suriyaṃ uggacchantaṃ oloketvā); Mil 90, 13 (~āya rattiyā uggate aruṇe); Vism 399, 3 (~āya rattiyā sarīrapaṭijagganaṃ katvā); — 2. ( n. ) daybreak, morning; Abh 68; Vin II 155, 34 (rattiyā sudaṃ tikkhattuṃ uṭṭhāsi ~aṃ maññamāno) ≠ S I 211, 5 ; Ap 531, 2 (~e viya tārāyo na dissanti jinorasā); Vism 664, 33 (~e rājagoṇā ti sañjānanaṃ); Mhv 14:42 (rājā ~e pāhesi rathaṃ); — atipabhāte , adv. , late in the morning, in broad daylight; Ja I 436, 14 (ayaṃ [kukkuṭo] atirattiṃ vā vassati ~e vā); — duppabhāta , n. , an ill dawn; Ap 153, 9 (dulladdhaṃ vata me āsi ~aṃ duruṭṭhitaṃ; Ap-a 424, 10 : ~an ti duṭṭhu pabhātaṃ rattiyā pabhātakaraṇaṃ mayhaṃ na suṭṭhu pabhātan ti attho); — suppabhāta , mfn. and n. , beautifully illuminated by dawn; a beautiful dawn, a good daybreak; A I 294, 24* (sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ ~aṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ); Sn 178 (suddiṭṭhaṃ vata no ajja ~aṃ suhuṭṭhitaṃ; Pj II 216, 14 : ajja amhākaṃ suṭṭhu pabhātaṃ sobhanaṃ vā pabhātaṃ ahosi) ≠ Vv 33:291 = Ja II 256, 21* ; Mil 126, 30 (~o te divaso, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se supabhāso).

pābhata n. , 1. [ cf S. prabhṛta] capital; money, property; Abh 471 (mūlaṃ tu ~aṃ); 1127; D I 135, 22 (ye … ussahanti vāṇijjāya tesaṃ bhavaṃ rājā ~aṃ anuppādetu; Sv 296, 28 : bhaṇḍamūlaṃ detū ti attho); A I 48, 20 (so diṭṭhadhammikassa vajjassa bhīto na paresaṃ ~aṃ palumpanto carati; Mp II 90, 20 foll.: paresaṃ santakaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ); Ja I 122, 21* (appakena pi medhāvī ~ena vicakkhaṇo samuṭṭhāpeti attānaṃ); V 452, 14* (tā gilanti purisassa ~aṃ; 454, 21´ : ~an ti dukkhasambhataṃ dhanaṃ gilanti nāsenti); Sv 262, 1 (laddhaṃ dāni me ~an ti); — 2. [ S., BHS prābhṛta] an offering, a present; Abh 355 (upadā tu ca ~aṃ); 1127; Ps IV 221, 15 (sabbe pi te rājāno attano attano rajjasirivibhavānurūpaṃ ~aṃ gahetvā); — ifc see kathā-; — see also apābhata, paṭipābhata.

pābhata.p: [ pa + ā + bhara + ta. Prābhasta-saṃ. ] (na) Google Translate (1) Premises; Treasury. (2) income stream property; capital goods. (3) The gift of a ruler.
